## Stripe Payment to Sheets and Email
Receives Stripe payment webhooks, logs revenue to Google Sheets, sends receipt via Gmail, and notifies via Telegram.

**Setup:**
1. Configure Stripe webhook to point to this workflow URL
2. Connect Google Sheets with your revenue spreadsheet
3. Set Gmail and Telegram credentials
